acquisition_method.evidence: This dataset corresponds to the proteomic characterization of the TMEM160 interactome in A549 cells using co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) followed by data-independent acquisition mass spectrometry (DIA-MS).

alkylation_reagent.evidence: The immunoprecipitated proteins were resuspended in 100 mM Tris pH 8.6, reduced with dithiothreitol (DTT), and alkylated with iodoacetamide.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were precipitated with cold ethanol and then digested with trypsin (1:50 enzyme-to-substrate ratio) at 37 °C for 16 h in digestion buffer (50 mM ammonium bicarbonate, 0.5% sodium deoxycholate).

collision_energy.evidence: For MS2, the resolution was set to 30,000, with an AGC target of 1 × 106, an automatic maximum injection time, and an NCE of 28.

fragmentation_method.evidence: inferred: For MS2, the resolution was set to 30,000, with an AGC target of 1 × 106, an automatic maximum injection time, and an NCE of 28.

instrument.evidence: Peptide samples were analyzed using a high-resolution LC-MS system (Dionex Ultimate 3000 RSLCnano UPLC coupled to a Q-Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer) (Thermo Fischer Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA).

ionization_type.evidence: The separation of peptides was performed in an EASY-spray RSLC C18 analytical column (2 µm, 100 Å, 75 µm i.d. × 50 cm) at a flow rate of 300 nL/min.

labeling.evidence: inferred: Protein identification and quantification were performed in DIA-NN (v1.8.1) in library-free mode using the UniProt Human reference proteome.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: Peptide samples were analyzed using a high-resolution LC-MS system (Dionex Ultimate 3000 RSLCnano UPLC coupled to a Q-Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer) (Thermo Fischer Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA).
